passages.text: The Orbit desk lamp comes with a two-year limited warranty from the date of purchase. The warranty covers the LED module, the arm joints and the touch switch. Keep the receipt; a partner shop can file the claim for the buyer.
The Orbit desk lamp has a dimmable LED module with five brightness levels and a warm-to-cool color slider on the base.
Warranty claims for any Atlas Widgets product are filed through the partner portal under Service, then New claim.

Partner shops accept returns of an unused Cable dock within 60 days of delivery. After 60 days the dock can only be sent in for repair under warranty, not returned for a refund. Returns need the original box.
The Cable dock holds up to four cables with weighted magnetic clips and comes in graphite and sand colors.
Refunds for returned items are paid to the original payment method within ten business days.
Orders to Canada leave the Seattle warehouse within two business days and usually arrive five to eight business days later. Import duties are prepaid, so the buyer pays nothing at the door.
Orders inside the United States ship by ground and arrive in three to five business days.
Canada partner shops can order samples of every product line twice a year through the sample program.
To update the Pebble speaker, open the Atlas Home app, choose the speaker and tap Check for updates. Keep the speaker on its charger during the update; it restarts by itself after about four minutes.
The Pebble speaker plays for twelve hours on a full charge and is rated IPX4 against splashes.
Firmware release notes for all connected products are posted on the Atlas Widgets status page.

The Drift fan runs for about nine hours on its lowest speed and about three hours on the highest speed. The battery recharges over USB-C in four hours and keeps 80 percent of its capacity after 500 cycles.
The Drift fan has three speeds and a quiet night mode that turns off the status light.
Lithium batteries in Atlas Widgets products ship at a partial charge to meet air freight rules.

Unplug the Slate keyboard and wipe the keys with a soft cloth dampened with water or isopropyl alcohol. Do not spray liquid into the keyboard. The keycaps can be pulled off with the included tool and washed by hand.
The Slate keyboard uses low-profile switches and connects over Bluetooth to up to three devices.
Cleaning kits with cloths and a small brush are available as an add-on for partner orders.
Plug the Halo webcam into a USB port on the laptop; it needs no driver and appears as a standard camera. To use the privacy shutter and auto framing, install the Atlas Home app and select the webcam.
The Halo webcam records 1080p video at 60 frames per second and has two built-in microphones.
Laptop stands from Atlas Widgets come in two heights and fold flat for travel.
The Orbit desk lamp is available in three finishes: matte black, brushed aluminum and coral. Coral is a limited run for the spring catalog and is sold only in boxes of six.
The Orbit desk lamp arm reaches 45 centimeters and the head tilts by 90 degrees.
Color swatches for every product line are included in the partner catalog PDF.
The Cable dock with the charging pad needs a USB-C power adapter of at least 20 watts. The plain dock without the pad needs no power. An adapter is not in the box.
The Cable dock is made from recycled aluminum and has a non-slip silicone base.
Power adapters sold by Atlas Widgets carry UL and CE certification marks.
Replacement arms, heads and bases for the Orbit lamp are sold as spare parts through the partner portal under Parts. A replacement arm costs 19 dollars and ships with the screws and a hex key.
The Orbit lamp head uses a 6-watt LED rated for 25,000 hours.
Spare parts orders under 50 dollars ship by standard mail without tracking.

A clicking Drift fan usually has a loose front grille. Turn the fan off, twist the grille until it locks with a click, and run it again. If the noise continues, the blade may be bent and the fan should be sent in under warranty.
The Drift fan oscillates through 80 degrees and can be mounted on a wall bracket.
Noise ratings for Atlas Widgets fans are measured at one meter in a quiet room.
Yes. The Halo webcam has a standard quarter-inch tripod thread under its clip, so it fits any camera tripod or desk arm. Remove the clip first by pressing the two release tabs.
The Halo webcam clip fits monitors from 1 to 7 centimeters thick.
Tripods and desk arms are not part of the Atlas Widgets catalog.
Atlas Widgets sells desk gadgets wholesale to partner shops in the United States and Canada.
Partner shops can reach the support team by chat on weekdays from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. Pacific time.
Prices in the partner catalog are wholesale prices and do not include sales tax.
Every Atlas Widgets product page lists its weight, dimensions and the materials it is made from.
